settings.title: Count the Pieces
settings.description: Confirm the physical pallet count matches the quantity written on the driver's delivery receipt.

settings.title: Inspect the Shrinkwrap
settings.description: Look for torn black plastic, crushed cardboard, or boot prints. Carriers will sometimes double-stack un-stackable freight and crush the bottom pallet.

settings.title: Note Damage ON THE PAPER
settings.description: If you see a single scuff or tear, write "FREIGHT DAMAGED / SUBJECT TO INSPECTION" clearly on the driver's paper before you sign your name.

settings.title: Take 3 Photos
settings.description: Take a wide shot of the truck/pallet, a close-up of the damage, and a clear photo of the signed delivery receipt. Text them instantly to (850) 816-7898.

settings.question: I got my tracking number, but Saia's website says "No Shipment Found."
settings.answer: We issue your PRO number the moment the pallet is strapped on our staging floor. However, tracking does not go live until the carrier's line-haul tractor picks up the pallet and physically scans it across the local outbound terminal dock (usually between 5:00 PM and 8:00 PM local time).

settings.question: Why do commercial drops take 2 days and residential drops take 4 days?
settings.answer: Motor freight carriers will not drive a 53-foot semi-truck into a residential neighborhood without calling the consignee (buyer) 24 hours in advance to schedule a delivery window.

settings.question: What is the liftgate requirement?
settings.answer: LTL freight arrives on a 4-foot dock-height trailer. If your jobsite does not have a loading dock, a forklift, or a loader with forks to pull the 1,500-lb pallet off the tail, your delivery must be flagged for Liftgate Service.

settings.question: Can I pick up my freight at the terminal?
settings.answer: If your pallet is sitting at the carrier's destination terminal in your city, but the final delivery truck isn't scheduled to drop it at your jobsite until tomorrow afternoon, you can go get it. Call our logistics desk — we will issue a formal Terminal Intercept authorizing you to drive your trailer directly to the carrier's freight yard and pick it up off their dock.
